title.en: A cryptography-inspired search finds a hidden pulsar
title.zh: 借来密码学算法，在旧数据中找到脉冲星

summary.en: A November19 study found an isolated gamma-ray pulsar in fifteen years of Fermi data with about ten CPU hours. Its dramatic case comparison opens a useful search frontier, with background and binary-system limits still clear.
summary.zh: 11月19日研究用约十个CPU小时，在费米望远镜十五年数据中找到孤立伽马射线脉冲星。个案计算优势带来新可能，背景噪声与双星搜索仍有边界。
